feature_contract: Unchanged canonical feature_matrix on exactly 256 already closed 5s bars; every source available_us <= decision_us; no future label columns in features.
interval_convention: Flow intervals use closed-bar availability stamps (start,end]; equivalently include source bars timestamp>=start and timestamp<end. Return anchors are last-trade close prices of bars ending exactly at start/end.
exact_window_note: The supplied LEAD_LAG bounds imply 295 seconds/59 bars on each side; do not silently replace either boundary with a 300-second window.
earliest_order_rule: For a past-only predicted signal earliest_permissible_order_us=decision_us+5s. For an observed-future-flow mechanism diagnostic earliest_permissible_order_us=flow_label_mature_us+5s. earliest_order_us is the same earliest permissible timestamp, while pre-registered active waiting is separately delayed_entry_us=return_label_start_us. Never equate active waiting with earliest permissible order.
split_metadata: Every row is explicitly TRAIN, VALIDATION, OOS_SCREENING, or DEVELOPMENT_DIAGNOSTIC; no implicit long-term-validation classification. No market model is fitted by label implementation tests.
price_proxy: CLOSED_BAR_RETURN_PROXY_NOT_EXECUTABLE_FILL: close at return_end / close at return_start - 1. Both exact boundary closes and their actual last-trade timestamps/availability are emitted; no BBO, ask/bid, fill, maker or cost qualification implied.
return_units: simple dimensionless return, bps only when explicitly multiplied by 10000
missing_policy: No interpolation, forward fill, dropped time grid or invented price; invalid future/price anchors produce label_valid=false and label values NaN. Future validity is for offline labels, never an online feature/filter.
maturity: Maximum actual source available_us needed for the label, including all intervening return-window bar quality and both price anchors; strictly >= nominal end. Delayed data may increase maturity beyond nominal lag and must be reflected in split receipt.
overlap_assertions: earliest permissible order == actual signal availability + fixed 5s latency
observed future flow maturity + 5s <= delayed entry for diagnostic use
actual return anchor trade timestamps ordered and within their corresponding already-closed 5s bars

FLOW_SURPRISE.primary_target: same contract's nonoverlapping subsequent Spot return
FLOW_SURPRISE.conditional_expectation_first_implementa: official sklearn Ridge(alpha=1.0) on the same past-only inputs, with official train-only StandardScaler; no custom online/learning framework
assertions: forecast IDs disjoint from each predictor's fitting IDs
all fitting label maturity <= actual fitting cutoff
max fitting maturity + embargo < min forecast decision
both M1 and conditional-expectation model exclude every scored forecast row
prediction components share same four original-unit flow outputs
forbidden: realized future flow as a prediction input
predictor refit after inspection of scored result

DIRECT_RETURN_BASELINE: Return targets are selected from the exact same label frame, never rebuilt. Require exact equality of endpoint IDs, train/validation/test IDs, feature set hash, dataset hash, protocol hash, cost hash, position-constraint hash, decision frequency and label variant. Equality asserted before comparing results.
scaler: Only explicitly declared train IDs, with availability no later than actual fitting cutoff; use official sklearn StandardScaler.
split: Actual fitting cutoff must be STRICTLY BEFORE validation_start - embargo - maximum actual label lag; fitting labels must mature no later than cutoff. Validation labels mature strictly before test_start - embargo. Registered research may use a more conservative lag, never smaller than observed maximum.
old_oracle_classification: SAME_WINDOW_IMPACT_DIAGNOSTIC; retain old artifacts, never interpret as tradable forecast ceiling.
